title: World Cup: ZaÎre-Emery overcome with emotion after first France apppearance
summary: Coming off the bench to play for Les Bleus, French midfielder Warren Zaïre-Emery was overcome with emotion while talking to reporters after a commanding 2-0 victory over Morocco. The 20-year-old reflected on his stellar season, both at his club PSG and for the French national team, adding that the work was far from over.
